linked_heading: 1. The question, the reading, the method
line_text: The [closed-universe note](../../cosmology/scale-factor-duality/closed-universe.md) asks what follows if the universe's space is closed, curvature k = +1, so that position space is a three-sphere S³ of radius R, or a space with the same local geometry and a different topology ([§1](../../../notes/closed-universe.md#1-the-question-the-reading-the-method)). Phase space is then the cotangent bundle T\*S³: over each point of S³ sits the [momentum fibre](momentum-fibers.md), the space of momenta available there [T]. The note's §5 asks what is left of [Born reciprocity](born-reciprocity.md), ρ: (x, p) → (p, −x), on that space.

[#11](../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md) states it in one line: "the dual-superconductor picture of confinement — chromomagnetic monopole condensation squeezing color-electric flux into strings — is the leading mechanism for why free quarks are never seen [T, 't Hooft–Mandelstam†]" ([§11.2](../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#112-the-full-dual-spectrum-t)). Chromomagnetic monopoles are magnetic charges of the color field; monopoles in general are the subject of [magnetic monopoles](monopoles/_index.md).

line_text: - [Conjecture: velocity clumping, the founding image](../dark-matter/momentum-clumping/founding-image.md) — founding supposition 3, "Matter clumps in momentum space", open, P.R.'s conjecture [O] ([#11 §9](../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#9-momentum-clumping-the-founding-image-tested); [App. A item 3](../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#appendix-a-audit-of-founding-suppositions-pr-with-fates)). The evidence, as [§9](../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#9-momentum-clumping-the-founding-image-tested) states it: for particles, the mean-field criterion g·n_gate ≥ m·min(σ, v\*)² "fails by 10²⁸–10³¹ at the scattering benchmark" [D], and by the [classicality theorem](../dark-matter/momentum-clumping/classicality-theorem.md) satisfying it at fixed σ₀/m "forces m ≲ 0.1 meV, where N_occ ~ 10²⁰ — collective momentum-space behavior and classical particles are mutually exclusive"; for the committed wave, Scenario A, condensation is mandatory only in ultra-faint dwarf galaxies, whose endpoint drains the halo, "**falsified** by observed UFD density and longevity" [D + T] (UFD: ultra-faint dwarf), a case itself [under review](../dark-matter/momentum-clumping/wave-island/scenario-a.md); for the free wave, "optional, never required"; and [the net theorem](../dark-matter/momentum-clumping/net-theorem.md): "velocity-space clumping is nowhere mandatory — forbidden (particles), fatal (committed wave), decorative (free wave)". "Results (i)–(iii) stand as results" ([§9](../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#9-momentum-clumping-the-founding-image-tested)). [App. A item 3](../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#appendix-a-audit-of-founding-suppositions-pr-with-fates) puts it as failing "for particle dark matter by 10²⁸–10³¹ (theory) and, where mandatory for wave dark matter (Scenario A, under review), against the faintest dwarfs (data)", and "optional for a free-coupling wave". The tests cover the program's contact-range gate on all three branches, and they say clumping is required nowhere, not that it is impossible; the velocity-gated-gravity note of 2026-10-28 (not reviewed) examined that scope and finds that the results hold for the program as written ([the scope of the tests](../dark-matter/momentum-clumping/founding-image.md#the-scope-of-the-tests)). linked_heading: 2. The hidden sector and its coupling
line_text: The referee found #14's citation supported but noted that v3 addressed neither the size of the monopoles' visible charge nor its consequence for the dark matter (Step 4(b)). Its own estimate (Step 4(a) item 7): "Hidden theta is physical (psi massive) and generically O(1): q_vis ~ chi theta_d/(2 pi)", by eq. 3.19 of Brümmer–Jaeckel–Khoze, which gives "1.6e-8 e (chi=1e-7, theta=1) to 1.6e-7 e (chi=1e-6)". The same item states the contradiction: [§2](../../../notes/knot-dark-matter-standalone.md#2-the-hidden-sector-and-its-coupling)(c)(ii) gives the dark matter itself a visible electric charge, yet [§2](../../../notes/knot-dark-matter-standalone.md#2-the-hidden-sector-and-its-coupling)(c) concludes that "the decisive constraints act on psi, not on the dark matter itself", and exclusion condition 1 treats any coupling of the dark matter to the Standard Model as fatal. The referee's judgement of the size: "Phenomenologically tiny at M=3e13 GeV, but it makes exclusion condition 1 self-triggering in the eps != 0 branch", M being the benchmark monopole mass. Among the constraints #14 had not evaluated, it listed the same point (Step 4(c) item 8): "monopoles are hidden dyons; visible charge ~1e-8-1e-7 e for eps~1e-7-1e-6".

On this page's reading, the modular structure on the charge side is the duality group acting on charges and on τ_c, SL(2, ℤ) for one gauge field, and on the phase-space side it is the continuous Sp(2d, ℝ) acting on the Siegel domain ([the two polarizations](unified-modular-structure.md#the-two-polarizations)). The checkpoint does not say what the enlarged structure would be. [§11.4](../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#114-the-magnetic-mirror-conjecture-o-pr-v23) records what it would give if one vacuum event selected both the position polarization and the electric sublattice: P.R.'s conjecture that "momentum matter is similar to position matter, each electrically charged x-polarized particle having a magnetically charged p-polarized analog" ([Conjecture: the momentum sector as the magnetic mirror](magnetic-identification.md)). The item, #14 v2's earlier and stronger form, and the related demand on the order parameter are on [Open: one modular structure for both polarizations (OP8)](unified-modular-structure.md).

linked_heading: B. The inconsistency, and the forced repair [D — structural]
line_text: In this wiki's reading, g⁻¹ is the metric general relativity puts on its fibers, so with both structures rigid the program's fibers are those of general relativity and its momentum space has no geometry of its own. Calc note #5 states the consequence for the program: "With H = diag(g, g⁻¹), S_H is a functional of g alone: a pure metric theory. No momentum graviton, hence no geometric origin for the χ gate either." ([§B](../../../notes/geometric-core.md#b-the-inconsistency-and-the-forced-repair-d--structural); [the collision with the theory as documented](../born-geometry/compatibility-corollaries.md#the-collision-with-the-theory-as-documented-d--structural)). The collision forced the change from [original P2](../../program/postulates/original-p2.md) to [P2′](../../program/postulates/p2-prime.md), under which only ω is rigid and the block form survives only on the vacuum slice: "At X = 0, H = diag(g, g⁻¹): the η-compatible locus of Theorem A is precisely the vacuum slice" ([#5 §C](../../../notes/geometric-core.md#c-the-modular-field-d--structural-math-facts-standard)).

Calc note #8 itself says "The field-equation problem: solved in structure", and [the handoff](../../history/documents/handoff.md) records it as "closes the field-equation problem (structural)" ([`HANDOFF.md` §3](../../../HANDOFF.md#3-artifact-inventory-creation-order)). #11 heads [§7](../../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#7-the-massive-momentum-graviton) "(the field-equation problem)" and keeps the open items above.
